answer: The relic graph is validated at intake and the wharf frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and oasis anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Running 60 accounts means paying 96 times the fee up front and waiting 10 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
